english: Throw it and it calls every zombie and animal within 40 blocks to the spot where it lands. Whatever reaches it stops to eat until it is gone.\nWhat comes running is up to you.
Zombie and Animal Bait made richer. One throw counts as 2 meals toward taming. Eats for longer before it is gone.
A whole feast for the creature that reaches it. One throw counts as 4 meals toward taming. Eats for a long time before it is gone.
A cheap scrap of rot that pulls zombies within 40 blocks to where it lands for about 45 seconds. Animals ignore it, and it does nothing toward taming. Throw it to clear a doorway or to get away.
